name: 0.20mm @Elegoo CC 0.4 - Experimental nonplanar
notes: Experimental fixed-upright-nozzle nonplanar trial. Fusion height check 2026-10-12: stock printable height 256 mm; raw CAD joint maximum tip-to-bed separation 260.300377 mm. Owner reports installed 0.4 mm toolhead dimensions and Z travel match CAD. No universal safe object height follows: budget the highest deposition, travel/lift, startup, parking and firmware motion for the actual job. The 100 mm setting is a software nozzle-Z ceiling, not 100 mm object height; current upstream print-height checking excludes custom startup/end scripts. Keep the first simple-ramp trial below 10 mm with 2 mm approach/departure. Gantry proxy 14 mm is relative to the nozzle, not maximum object height. See resources/profiles/Elegoo/NONPLANAR_CENTAURI.md. Prior trial reported transition/support/stringing defects; no contact noticed.
